$meta.name: The Monkey Vault — member app
$meta.purpose: Content + IA spec for the members app first draft. This is the design's data, extracted 1:1 from the concept. Live values (schedule, prices, passes, visits) should come from the members-app backend — see $liveDataSources.
notes: Category accent colours are the single source of truth in categories.js — do not hardcode; resolve by key.
All booking/store/waiver URLs route through site-config.js — use the canonical key, never a pasted URL.
Sample member data (name, days-left, passes, visits) is placeholder to show the shape; replace with the logged-in member's real record.

$liveDataSources.memberProfile: members-app backend (name, memberSince, membership status, days remaining, waiver status)
$liveDataSources.passes: members-app backend (active memberships + class packs with remaining counts)

membershipCard._note: days + membership name come from memberProfile
